## {.sidebar}

```{python}
#| echo: false
from pathlib import Path

import pandas as pd

# Quarto runs the kernel in the folder of this file, so this path is relative
# to index.qmd and not to the directory the command was started from.
data_dir = Path("../../_shared/data")
ojs_define(
    overview=pd.read_csv(data_dir / "overview.csv"),
    meta=pd.read_csv(data_dir / "meta.csv", dtype=str).iloc[0].to_dict(),
)
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
viewof state = Inputs.select(["Alle Bundesländer", ...states], {label: "Bundesland"})
viewof types = Inputs.checkbox(categories, {label: "Leistungstyp", value: categories, format: (c) => c.label})
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
//| include: false
rows = transpose(overview)
categories = [
  {key: "hpc", label: "HPC-Laden (>= 150 kW)", color: "#00B092"},
  {key: "schnell", label: "Schnellladen (> 22 kW)", color: "#003247"},
  {key: "normal", label: "Normalladen (<= 22 kW)", color: "#D3D3D3"}
]
states = [...new Set(rows.map((d) => d.bundesland))].sort((a, b) => a.localeCompare(b, "de"))

// Calculation logic from 05_ui_prototypes/README.md.
selected = types.map((c) => c.key)
filtered = state === "Alle Bundesländer" ? rows : rows.filter((d) => d.bundesland === state)
matching = filtered.filter((d) => selected.some((k) => d[`has_${k}`]))
// Block form: a parenthesized object literal with several keys is silently
// dropped by Quarto 1.10 dashboards.
kpis = {
  return {
    stations: fmt(d3.sum(matching, (d) => d.stationen)),
    points: fmt(d3.sum(filtered, (d) => d3.sum(selected, (k) => d[`lp_${k}`]))),
    hpc: fmt(selected.includes("hpc") ? d3.sum(filtered, (d) => d.lp_hpc) : 0),
    gw: `${fmt(d3.sum(matching, (d) => d.kw) / 1e6, 2)} GW`
  }
}
additions = d3
  .flatRollup(
    filtered.filter((d) => d.jahr >= 2010).flatMap((d) => types.map((c) => ({...c, jahr: d.jahr, lp: d[`lp_${c.key}`]}))),
    (v) => d3.sum(v, (d) => d.lp),
    (d) => d.jahr,
    (d) => d.label
  )
  .map(([jahr, label, lp]) => ({jahr, label, lp}))

fmt = (x, digits = 0) => x.toLocaleString("de-DE", {minimumFractionDigits: digits, maximumFractionDigits: digits})

hint = selected.length ? "" : "Bitte wähle mindestens einen Leistungstyp aus."

// An empty selection hides KPIs and charts via CSS (see theme.scss).
document.body.classList.toggle("no-selection", selected.length === 0)
```

### Row {.charts height="70%"}

```{ojs}
//| title: Jährlicher Zubau von Ladepunkten (Gesamt)
Plot.plot({
  height: 420,
  marginLeft: 60,
  x: {label: null, tickFormat: (y) => (y % (width < 600 ? 4 : 2) ? "" : String(y))},
  y: {label: "Ladepunkte", grid: true, tickFormat: (y) => fmt(y)},
  marks: [Plot.barY(additions, Plot.groupX({y: "sum"}, {x: "jahr", y: "lp", fill: "#003247", tip: true}))]
})
```

```{ojs}
//| title: Jährlicher Zubau nach Leistungstyp
Plot.plot({
  height: 420,
  marginLeft: 60,
  x: {label: null, tickFormat: (y) => (y % (width < 600 ? 4 : 2) ? "" : String(y))},
  y: {label: "Ladepunkte", grid: true, tickFormat: (y) => fmt(y)},
  color: {domain: types.map((c) => c.label), range: types.map((c) => c.color), legend: true},
  marks: [Plot.barY(additions, {x: "jahr", y: "lp", fill: "label", order: types.map((c) => c.label), tip: true})]
})
```
